verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is an API-driven cloud browser platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for agents is a fair axis to judge it on. Nothing in the evidence pack documents API key scoping, permissions, or per-agent credential issuance; the material covers sessions, agents, MCP, sandboxes and pricing only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
